content.short: iZiSwap is an advanced multi-chain DL-AMM DEX offering efficient concentrated liquidity and on-chain limit orders.
content.description: iZiSwap is an advanced multi-chain decentralized exchange powered by iZUMi Finance, utilizing a unique Discretized-Liquidity AMM (DL-AMM) model. This design allows for precise concentrated liquidity, making it highly efficient for stablecoin swaps and limit orders. Operating across major networks like Linea, Scroll, and Mantle, iZiSwap serves as a primary liquidity hub, providing users with professional-grade tools and minimal slippage. By leveraging discretized price ticks, it delivers the speed of an order book within a fully decentralized and capital-efficient framework.
